{{Quote|Surrender your training weapon, Tyro.|This apprentice to [[Vestara Khai]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
This '''[[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]''' was present when [[Vestara Khai]] was in the [[Circle of Lords]]. He Took Vestara's [[Training lightsaber/Legends|training lightsaber]] and gave her a [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]]. He was also a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. He wore black robes and a bright red sash that marked him as an apprentice.
